h: Wisdom Strength and Wealth Endure Through Recognizing Their Giver

p: We say at the third meal of Shabbos,
"Hashem is my shepherd, I shall not lack";
that is, the main thing is
that they recognize the power of the Giver:
(רַבָּה וְתַנְחוּמָא פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, בְּמִדְבַּר רַבָּה כב, ז)
(Rabbah and Tanchuma on this parsha, Bamidbar Rabbah 22:7):
"Three gifts were created in the world;
one who merited one of them
took the treasure of the whole world:
which is the wisdom of the Torah,
includes the treasure of the whole world.
and such a one merits might
שֶׁכָּל שְׁלִיטַת הָאוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל
For all the dominion of the nations over Yisrael
is through "the leaven in the dough"
found in the heart of Yisrael from their kelipah;
and one who conquers his inclination
and this is "merited might — merited everything."
refers to the performance of mitzvos,
Rabbi Akiva honored the wealthy, etc.,
appoint that they may preserve him'" (Tehillim 61:8)
that he does acts of kindness with his money.
When they are gifts of Heaven
and come through the power of Torah."
that Hashem Yisbarach is the One Who gives him
"And come through the power of Torah":
this is based on what we said,
and that is the intent for the sake of Heaven
because he was commanded by Hashem Yisbarach
כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוַּנִי ה׳ אֱלֹהָי (דְּבָרִים ד, ה)
and it is the light, the flame,
in the particular mitzvah he does.
without intent for the sake of Heaven,
הוּא גַּם כֵּן מִצְוָה כְּכָל הַמִּצְוֹת
is also a mitzvah like all the mitzvos,
and it is like a lamp and wick
Only when he learns for its own sake,
with intent for the sake of Heaven,
לְהַכִּיר עַל יְדֵי זֶה אֶת ה׳
and this light from the Torah
And this is the meaning of
"and come through the power of Torah":
that there is in it the "Torah is light."
of flesh and blood is nothing."
And it did not mention the third gift,
for with wisdom, that is Torah,
it is not fitting to say "it is nothing";
for even when he does not have
the intent for the sake of Heaven,
even not for their own sake, etc.";
and it is not fitting to say "it is nothing."
if he does not recognize the power of the Giver
and it does not come through the power of Torah,
And this is why it says "Hashem is my shepherd":
and they are gifts of Heaven
and come through the power of Torah;
that everything is from Hashem Yisbarach;
and because of this we say this psalm
For on Shabbos they also merit
for on Shabbos every single Jew
is called "those who fear My Name,"
and "the awe of Shabbos is upon the unlearned";
that the Torah was given on Shabbos;
"The blessing of Hashem, it makes rich"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשָׁה יא)
as is written (Bereishis Rabbah, beginning of chapter 11);
that they recognize the power of the Giver:
"Hashem is my shepherd, I shall not lack."
